title: Crazy Women (film)
extracted_sentences: Crazy Women () is a 1977 Argentine drama film written by Jose P. Dominiani and directed by Enrique Carreras.
It was entered into the 10th Moscow International Film Festival where Mercedes Carreras won the award for Best Actress .
